reasons.braces: Advisory covers every published version (npm's only fix is `npm audit fix --force` -> tailwindcss v4). Build/dev chain, never shipped to users.
reasons.chokidar: Same chain: chokidar -> braces, reachable only from tailwindcss 3.x. Fixed only by the breaking tailwindcss v4 migration.
reasons.fast-glob: Reachable only through tailwindcss 3.x -> micromatch. Build/dev chain.
reasons.micromatch: Reachable only through tailwindcss 3.x. Build/dev chain.
reasons.tailwindcss: Root of the chain above. Upgrading to v4 changes the build config (@theme / @tailwindcss/postcss) and is tracked separately as a post-launch item; it is a build-time DoS risk, not a shipped runtime one.
